0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 11th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, 3 games back) travel to the Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the West) for their 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Magic 3-3 on the road and 0-4 at home. Utah is on a nine-game losing streak, is 1-5 at home and 1-9 over its last ten, and sits 7 games back in fifth in the Northwest, while Orlando will be without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero and Tristan da Silva, and Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic, Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen. The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, but the Magic won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 120-117 win in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
